mechanism: Propylthiouracil can cause agranulocytosis and bone marrow suppression, which is potentiated by tranylcypromine's potential to cause similar hematologic effects; additionally, both drugs carry independent risks that compound when co-administered.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor complete blood counts closely and educate patient on signs of infection or unusual bruising; consider alternative antithyroid or antidepressant agents.
